review:
36 Coins x3000 is a full-grid Coins game: 36 positions, very little happening in the base game, and nearly all the value in the Hold the Jackpot bonus. Filling all 36 positions awards the 3,000x Grand Jackpot, and Mini, Minor and Major jackpots can drop during the round.

Sticky to Infinity marks Cluster Collector, Mystery and Jackpot Mystery symbols in the base game so they stay fixed until the bonus ends, which fills the board and makes the round easier to trigger. Cash Infinity symbols carry 5x to 10x and pay at the final reveal. The Cluster Collector gathers neighbouring cash values for up to five spins, then pays the total. Wazdan publishes a 96.15% RTP and high volatility. Suited to patient players who enjoy filling a grid.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
